FreeRTOS with mutexes for task coordination plus SPI/I2C/UART peripherals (Object Tracking Turret)

GenAI/LLM depth well past a day-to-day user: transformer from scratch, TinyLlama quantization, voice-controlled arm pipeline

No IAR/Keil toolchain, no AWS/cloud IoT, no formal unit/regression test frameworks for firmware
Seniority: 5+ years and 'extensive' on every core ask against 0 full-time years
overstated_by_keywords: BLE (HC-05 is Bluetooth classic over UART, not a BLE stack)
computer architecture (coursework, not hardware-level design work)
embedded Linux (systemd on Jetson is deployment, not kernel or driver work)
understated_by_keywords: GenAI building: COFFIN and the from-scratch transformer exceed the 'GenAI user' ask
screening_gaps: No embedded wireless depth (Wi-Fi, real BLE stack) when it is the headline required skill
0 full-time years vs 5+ years 'extensive' experience and technical leadership expectation

llm_analysis.reasoning: Core low-level skills (C, ARM Cortex-M, ISRs, drivers, FreeRTOS, SPI/I2C/UART) are genuinely backed, but the role's wireless, battery-power and shipped-camera-firmware centre is not. Reasonable to try given the strong GenAI angle and an EU role with a clean visa picture; expect the seniority bar to be the main filter.
